items.title: Micron Gained Memory Market Share. The Stock Is Dropping Anyway.
items.summary: Micron Technology   notched its second day of losses after briefly regaining its $1,000 share price on Monday.  Despite the decline, Micron’s business looks healthy as it gains market share.  There’s still no sign that memory-chip prices will do anything but continue to soar across both dynamic random-access memory (DRAM) and NAND flash memory.
